channel.title: Holy City Sinner - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Major Leo Twiggs Retrospective Opens at Gibbes Museum of Art
item.description: The world premiere of Revelations: The Art of Leo Twiggs, a major retrospective spanning six decades of work by the nationally acclaimed artist, is now on view at the Gibbes Museum of Art through May 3.

item.title: Mt. Pleasant’s “Dine Where You Live” Campaign Returns Next Month
item.description: Coming off the heels of Charleston Restaurant Week, the Town of Mount Pleasant and the Mount Pleasant Chamber of Commerce (MPCC) are teaming up to keep the table set for local eateries.

item.title: Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary Seeking Help After Multiple Puppies Found Abandoned in Freezing Conditions
item.description: Hallie Hill Animal Sanctuary is asking for the public’s help after multiple puppies were found abandoned Saturday night along a busy roadside near the sanctuary.

item.title: Restaurant Applications Now Available for 34th Annual Taste of Alpharetta
item.description: Downtown Alpharetta will serve up a world of flavor when the 34th annual Taste of Alpharetta returns on Thursday, May 14, 2026, from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m.

item.title: Tanger Outlets Charleston Awards 2025 TangerKids Grants
item.description: As part of its ongoing dedication to education and community impact, Tanger Outlets Charleston has announced the recipients of its 2025 TangerKids Grants.

item.title: Charleston Battery’s Open Cup First Round match set for March 18 against Badgers FC at home
item.description: The U.S. Soccer Federation confirmed Tuesday the match details for the First Round of the 2026 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup, the 111th edition of the historic tournament.

item.title: Charleston Gaillard Center Announces Three Local Honorees for Monuments Outdoor Installation
item.description: The Charleston Gaillard Center today announced three Charlestonians to be honored in Monuments, an outdoor projection-based installation by internationally acclaimed artist Craig Walsh.

item.title: Charleston Southern Announces Addition of Women's Flag Football as Varsity Program
item.description: The Charleston Southern University Athletic Department announced on Tuesday afternoon the addition of Women’s Flag Football as a varsity intercollegiate sport to be added to the university’s offerings.

item.title: Mac Deford Campaign Questions Poll That Omits Candidate
item.description: The Mac Deford for Congress campaign is responding with bemusement to reports of a new poll in South Carolina’s 1st Congressional District that does not include Mac Deford among the Democratic candidates tested.

item.title: Protein Bread Recipes: Protein-Bread.com Explains the Cottage Cheese Trend
item.description: Social media feeds exploded recently with videos of people baking bread. The secret ingredient? Cottage cheese is mixed directly into the dough. The comments sections are filled with skeptics questioning the taste. Early testers reported back: the family loved the results completely.
